name: Pacific Furniture Manufacturing
old_description: Proudly Family-Owned and Handcrafted in Phoenix, AZ since 1958.
about:
Pacific Furniture Manufacturing, operating as Pacific Seasons, has been a family-owned business in Phoenix, Arizona since 1958. The company was founded on a commitment to handcrafted upholstered furniture made locally.

The company designs, fabricates, and upholsters custom furniture in its Phoenix factory, where a team of craftsmen—some with more than 25 years of tenure—build each piece from sustainably sourced raw materials. The process moves from design through fabrication to final upholstery, allowing for fully customized pieces as well as curated collections.

Pacific Seasons serves residential clients and interior designers, offering private showroom appointments in Scottsdale and factory visits for design professionals. The company emphasizes collaboration with designers looking for manufacturing partners to expand their portfolios.

The business distinguishes itself through its family ownership, domestic production, and a workforce with deep institutional knowledge. Leadership includes President Grace Hansen, COO Chris Hansen, and Plant Manager Brent Hansen, who collectively bring decades of experience in operations, supply chain, and high-volume manufacturing.
